name: litter
description: Design, execute and fanout runs as Claude Code workflows, with a mod that records every step, runs verify itself and lands only verified trees

verify.title: Verify command
verify.description: The command that decides whether a gate is done, as an argument list with no shell string, e.g. uv run pytest tests/ -q. litter runs it itself and records the exit code.

goalCheck.title: Goal check command
goalCheck.description: Optional. An argument list that checks a goal-mode run's goal at the end. Usually set per run when you launch.

setup.title: Worktree setup command
setup.description: Optional. An argument list run in the root of each fresh worktree litter makes, to install dependencies (e.g. npm ci). It must be safe to run twice.

linkDirs.title: Directories to link into worktrees
linkDirs.description: Optional. Ignored directories (e.g. node_modules) linked from your checkout into each fresh worktree instead of a setup run.

verifyTimeoutMs.title: Verify timeout (ms)
verifyTimeoutMs.description: The longest a verify, goal check or setup run may take before litter kills it and records it as timed out.

maxAttempts.title: Attempts per gate
maxAttempts.description: How many executor attempts a gate gets before the run halts.

maxRounds.title: Design rounds
maxRounds.description: How many rounds a design run gets before it stops for you.

summaryModel.title: Swarm summary model
summaryModel.description: The model for the swarm browser's generated summary, resolved like --model; off disables it.

summaryEverySec.title: Swarm summary interval (s)
summaryEverySec.description: The shortest gap between two generated swarm summaries.
